source_dimensions.fork_length: SNL:87:003 prints 1½ inch without datum. Selected pin-axis to threaded-face distance is a hypothesis. Overall-length interpretation is retained as a separate diagnostic.
source_dimensions.pin_length: SNL:136:007 physical M568A prints 1⅝ inch; underhead-to-tip datum assumed. SNL:71:031 calls M568A 1⅞ inch, an unresolved conflict.
source_dimensions.cotter: SNL:136:008 prints ⅛ x1 inch. Formed legs each preserve stated under-eye centerline length; circular twin-wire/eye form is approximate.
source_dimensions.rod_thread: SNL:195:008 specifies two ¾ inch plain nuts per M575 assembly. One is at this rear fork; the other belongs to its future forward joint.

interpretation: Assign the two M569B forks to the wider brake-lever ends of the two M575 rear rods and M569C to their forward ends. This follows specific application and quantity, not a proven explicit end label.
